title: Cloud Storage: New Hard Delete Pause for Soft-Deleted Objects
summary: Cloud Storage buckets now support a 'hard delete pause' configuration within their soft delete policy. This new feature allows administrators to temporarily prevent the permanent deletion of soft-deleted objects, offering an additional layer of data protection.
details: The `Bucket` schema has been updated with a new `hardDeletePause` object under `properties.softDeletePolicy`. This new configuration includes an `enabled` boolean property to activate or deactivate the pause, and an `effectiveTime` string property (RFC 3339 format) indicating when the pause became active. When enabled, soft-deleted objects in the bucket will not be permanently deleted until the hard delete pause is explicitly disabled, providing more control over data retention and recovery.
